rics.meaning: China GDP: GDP Implicit Price Deflator. Sub-aggregate or alternative measure of GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Use alongside headline GDP YoY (aCNCGDPYD/A) for full national accounts picture. Different vintages and aggregations capture different aspects: by-expenditure, by-industry, by-province.
